data.body: FINAL_REMEDIATION: Add warn-mode boundary test — DSO_DSO_ID_GUARD_MODE=warn + unauthorized write → no exception raised + warning logged (assert via caplog fixture or mock logger; assert log record level=WARNING, message contains 'DSO_ID_GUARD' and the offending leaf_name + payload). Add env-vs-config precedence test (closes dd_collective_ac_coverage gap from cycle 3): (a) env=warn + config=raise → warn behavior (env wins); (b) env=raise + config=warn → raise behavior (env wins); (c) env unset + config=warn → warn behavior (config fallback); (d) env unset + config unset → raise (default). 4 parametrized cases.
